queries: SELECT m.MediaTypeId, AVG(t.UnitPrice) AS avg_unit_price, AVG(t.UnitPrice) * 1.0 / NULLIF((SELECT AVG(UnitPrice) FROM Track), 0) AS ratio FROM MediaType m LEFT JOIN Track t ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId ORDER BY CASE WHEN AVG(t.UnitPrice) * 1.0 / NULLIF((SELECT AVG(UnitPrice) FROM Track), 0) IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, ratio DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT t.MediaTypeId, AVG(t.UnitPrice) AS avg_unit_price, AVG(t.UnitPrice) * 1.0 / NULLIF((SELECT AVG(UnitPrice) FROM Track), 0) AS ratio FROM Track t GROUP BY t.MediaTypeId ORDER BY CASE WHEN AVG(t.UnitPrice) * 1.0 / NULLIF((SELECT AVG(UnitPrice) FROM Track), 0) IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, ratio DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT t.MediaTypeId, AVG(t.UnitPrice) AS avg_unit_price, AVG(t.UnitPrice) * 1.0 / (SELECT AVG(UnitPrice) FROM Track) AS ratio_to_overall FROM Track t GROUP BY t.MediaTypeId ORDER BY (CASE WHEN AVG(t.UnitPrice) * 1.0 / (SELECT AVG(UnitPrice) FROM Track) IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), ratio_to_overall DESC, t.MediaTypeId LIMIT 10

responses.sql: SELECT m.MediaTypeId, AVG(t.UnitPrice) AS avg_unit_price, AVG(t.UnitPrice) * 1.0 / NULLIF((SELECT AVG(UnitPrice) FROM Track), 0) AS ratio FROM MediaType m LEFT JOIN Track t ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId ORDER BY CASE WHEN AVG(t.UnitPrice) * 1.0 / NULLIF((SELECT AVG(UnitPrice) FROM Track), 0) IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, ratio DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: The overall average is the mean of UnitPrice over all tracks (each track weighted equally), not an average of the per-media-type averages.
Every row in MediaType counts as a media type, including types with no tracks. Those get a NULL average and NULL ratio and sort last.
The price is Track.UnitPrice (the list price), not InvoiceLine.UnitPrice (the sold price).

alternatives.interpretation: Only media type IDs that appear on at least one track are included. Types with no tracks are omitted.

Only media types that have at least one track are listed, since the average price comes from Track.
